title: Jo Jones and Lester Young drafted
summary: They recall that Jo and Lester went into the Army, which hurt the band; Shadow Wilson took over.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: No. Well, listen, Freddie, let's go back to where the character of the band is changing a little bit then.
So, are we up to -- what -- about 1940 -- Stan?
No. No. Actually we don't really -- the band doesn't change too much until you get --
More or less. Yeah -- I guess you could really say it's more or less when Jo -- Jo and Lester are gone.
Well, what about -- what about? I think I wasn't around then either, because I was in the Army, too.
What was it? What happened about Jo?
Well, when Jo went out of the band -- how come Jo went out of the band?
Did he, too? Was he drafted?
I knew Lester was. I never realized Jo was drafted.
Yeah. But, I don't know what happened after he came out of the Army. While he was away -- who came in?
He went in the Army in '44 and came back to Basie in '46.
Shadow. It had to be Shadow, --
-- because he's the only one that I could remember.
Yeah. But, the only one I could think of after Jo, would be Shadow.
Because -- I mean -- that was a shattering blow to the band to lose Jo and Lester.
After you've gone all those years without practically losing anyone that means any -- that has any real effect on the band.
